recognize_zh: 這顆中性球細胞質幾乎沒有顆粒、呈淡灰粉色（hypogranular），核分葉異常且染色質粗塊狀凝集，是典型的顆粒球系發育不良（dysgranulopoiesis）；在 GATA2 胚系突變病人提示 MDS。
features: Markedly hypogranular, pale pink-gray cytoplasm with only sparse fine granules
Abnormal nuclear segmentation: two to three irregular lobes with a poorly formed configuration
Background red cells with mild poikilocytosis (occasional teardrop and elliptocytes); platelets present
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a neutrophil with markedly hypogranular, pale cytoplasm and an abnormally segmented nucleus composed of irregular lobes with coarse, clumped chromatin. Background red cells show mild poikilocytosis including occasional teardrop cells and elliptocytes, and platelets are present. These are dysplastic granulocytic features; in a patient with a germline GATA2 mutation, findings are consistent with myelodysplastic syndrome with germline GATA2 predisposition. Assessment of dysplasia requires ≥10% of neutrophils to be affected and correlation with marrow morphology and cytogenetics.

ddx.dx: Pseudo-Pelger-Huët change from drugs (e.g., mycophenolate, tacrolimus) or HIV
ddx.vs: Morphology can be identical; drug/infection history and lack of multilineage dysplasia, cytopenias or clonal cytogenetics favor a reactive cause.
Affects nearly all neutrophils with bilobed/round nuclei and normal granulation, without cytopenias.
Artifactual hypogranularity affects all cells uniformly, whereas true dysplasia is heterogeneous and accompanied by nuclear hyposegmentation.
Also shows dysgranulopoiesis but requires persistent absolute monocytosis ≥0.5 × 10^9/L with ≥10% monocytes.
